# artisanvirt_cluster (Resource)

A Corosync/Pacemaker cluster created on an initial hypervisor. Add more members with `artisanvirt_cluster_member`. The API has no update operation, so any change replaces the cluster; a cluster can only be destroyed when it contains no VMs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "artisanvirt_cluster" "fsn1" {
  name             = "fsn1-prod"
  location         = "fsn1"
  initial_node_id  = artisanvirt_node.hv01.id
  ring_subnet      = "10.10.0.0/24"
  storage_strategy = "replicated"

  fencing_enabled = true
  fencing_agent   = "fence_ipmilan"

  timeouts {
    create = "90m"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `initial_node_id` (String) Ready node the cluster is bootstrapped on.
- `name` (String) Cluster name.

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `fencing_agent` (String) Fence agent, e.g. `fence_ipmilan`; required when fencing is enabled.
- `fencing_enabled` (Boolean) Enable STONITH fencing. Defaults to `false`.
- `location` (String) Datacenter / region label, e.g. `fsn1`.
- `qdevice_host` (String) QDevice host; required when `quorum_mode = "qdevice"`.
- `quorum_mode` (String) `majority` (default) or `qdevice`.
- `ring_subnet` (String) CIDR for the Corosync ring, for example `10.10.0.0/24`.
- `storage_strategy` (String) `local` (default), `replicated` (DRBD) or `shared`.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `transport` (String) Corosync transport. Defaults to `knet`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String) Cluster status.
- `status_message` (String) Status detail.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import artisanvirt_cluster.fsn1 cl-0123456789abcdef
```
